patch_description: Replace the random-point placeholder with a constrained-optimization pipeline. The ratio dmin/dmax is scale-invariant, so we fix dmax ≤ 1 via explicit constraints and maximize a slack variable t subject to t² ≤ ||xi−xj||² for every pair, solved with SLSQP. The code is modularized into: seeding (deterministic multi-start candidates including an icosahedral configuration), constraint builders (vectorized pair distance functions), a solve stage, and a best-of restarts selection with final ratio-based renormalization. This directly attacks the true metric (squared ratio) instead of relying on luck, and targets the known reference ratio 1/4.1658 for 14 points in 3D.
